title: GET /v1/agent-pairings/{pairing_id} response
description: Body of a successful response to GET /v1/agent-pairings/{pairing_id} (11-agent-access.md section 4).

remote.description: present (true) only for a pairing from another computer (ADR-067)

nonce.description: the hub's nonce of a remote pairing, input of the agent code (11-agent-access.md section 3); present exactly with remote

gen.description: present when the request is signed by a user (browser session or agent): the generation the user's certificate of this pairing must name (ADR-082 section 9.1)
